Snapshot is an off-chain voting platform used for decentralized autonomous organization governance. Snapshot allows token holders to vote without paying gas fees. Snapshot records votes as signed messages rather than on-chain transactions.

Nexus Mutual is a decentralized discretionary mutual that provides cover against smart contract failures. Nexus Mutual operates on the Ethereum blockchain. Nexus Mutual members stake its native token NXM to back the cover pool. Nexus Mutual assesses claims through member voting.

Terra USD is an algorithmic stablecoin designed to hold a peg to the US dollar. Terra USD was issued on the Terra blockchain. Terra USD maintained its peg through a mint-and-burn mechanism with the LUNA token rather than through fiat reserves. Terra USD lost its peg in May 2022.

PancakeSwap is a decentralized exchange that uses an automated market maker model. PancakeSwap operates on the BNB Smart Chain. PancakeSwap uses its native token CAKE for governance and incentives. PancakeSwap allows users to trade tokens without a centralized intermediary.

Hyperliquid is a decentralized perpetual futures exchange. Hyperliquid runs on its own layer-1 blockchain. Hyperliquid uses an on-chain central limit order book for trading. Hyperliquid has its own native token, HYPE.
